name: Luoyang Xinqianglian Slewing Bearing Co., Ltd.
summary: Luoyang Xinqianglian Slewing Bearing Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing of wind turbine business in China. The company offers wind turbine main shaft bearings, yaw bearings, pitch bearings, marine engineering equipment crane slewing bearings, tunnel boring bearings and key components, gear wheel box bearings, wind turbine locking discs, wind turbine high-speed couplings, slewing bearing rolling elements, slewing bearing cages, and industrial forgings products. It also engages in the photovoltaic and wind power generation business. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Luoyang, China.
